verdict.rationale: Bento documents bulk create/update of subscribers via API at 1–1000 records per request without triggering automations, and custom fields are a first-class concept that can also be updated through the Events API. Suppression is not shown as an API operation: the only related items are an unsubscribe-date filter and an anonymization/deletion endpoint, which is erasure rather than suppression. Missing for 10: a documented API to suppress or unsubscribe contacts, rate-limit or throughput guidance for production scale, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
